channel.title: Nation of Change – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change – Bias and Credibility (nationofchange.org)

item.title: ‘Gerrymandering Arms Race’: GOP rushes to erase clack representation after SCOTUS guts voting rights
item.description: Since the court issued its ruling last week, Republican-controlled states have begun to redraw their voting maps in a “gerrymandering arms race” that “could lead to the largest drop in Black representation since the Jim Crow era,” explains Berman.

item.title: Leaked CIA analysis undermines Trump administration’s claims of Iranian collapse
item.description: Intelligence findings reportedly showed Iran retained most of its missile capabilities and could withstand a U.S. blockade for months even as Trump officials publicly declared victory.

item.title: Federal court rules Trump tariffs unlawful again as manufacturing promises continue to unravel
item.description: New trade data shows manufacturing jobs falling and deficits rising even as the administration pushes to preserve its sweeping tariff agenda through alternative legal strategies.

item.title: Del Monte Bankruptcy to destroy 420,000 Peach Trees in California
item.description: A steady decline in demand for canned products as consumers shift toward fresh produce and several other factors led to this collapse.

item.title: The Age of Arrogant Amateurism – as ‘know-it-all’ opportunists seize power to control, not enlighten
item.description: To win big in this brave new world, forget tested skill-sets and the wisdom of experience: chutzpah and risk-taking, even gambling, are paramount, then the facile ability to learn on the job how to cling to power.

item.title: ICE at the gates: Rights groups warn Trump airport deployment risks civil liberties crisis
item.description: Civil liberties advocates, unions, and lawmakers raise alarm over use of immigration agents in airport security amid shutdown-driven staffing crisis.

item.title: Multi-million dollar agreement to import giant pandas from China collapses
item.description: Reports from advocacy groups like SF Zoo Watch and In Defense of Animals call on Mayor Daniel Lurie to halt new animal acquisitions and transform the 100-acre site from a traditional exhibition-based zoo into a 21st-century ecological park.

item.title: Mo. Senator Eric Schmitt’s asinine SHIELD Act would classify blowing whistles as ‘Obstruction of Justice’
item.description: Meanwhile Schmitt ignores blatant obstruction by Bondi’s DOJ.
